$description: Component contracts for the ZITO 1950 site. Visual spec: design/DESIGN.md; tokens: design/zito.tokens.json. All copy from src/data/content.ts (types in src/data/types.ts).

components.name: Header
components.behaviour: Sticky white bar 72px, logo.svg left, anchor nav (#storia, #orologi, #profumo, #contatti); hairline bottom border after scroll; mobile menu dialog.

components.name: Hero
components.behaviour: Editorial split: display title + short source text left, img/hero/hero.jpg right (eager, fetchpriority high).

components.name: StoriaChapter
components.behaviour: Narrow reading column with optional image; alternating sides on desktop, single column below 768px.

components.name: Pillar
components.behaviour: Text-only value block separated by hairlines; no icons.

components.name: ModelCard
components.behaviour: Button: image in well (object-fit contain), name in serif, codes + price in small. Opens ModelDialog.

components.name: ModelDialog
components.behaviour: Native <dialog> modal: image views, name, codes, price, quote, description, specs list. Esc/backdrop closes, focus returns to card.

components.name: Profumo
components.behaviour: N°7 Oud section: image + source text, exactly as printed.

components.name: Contatti
components.behaviour: Address, Numero Verde as tel: link, website, social links; <address> element.

components.name: Footer
components.behaviour: White footer, hairline top, logo-mark, legal name GRANALIDA s.r.l., nav repeat.
